title: CoreWeave signs $1.17B deal making VAST Data its main data platform

sources.quote: VAST Data, the AI Operating System company, today announced it has signed a commercial agreement valued at $1.17 billion with CoreWeave, the essential cloud for AI.

explain: CoreWeave, which rents out Nvidia GPUs, agreed to pay VAST Data about $1.17 billion for the software that stores and moves the data its AI customers train and run models on. It makes VAST the main data layer across CoreWeave's cloud.
